'''2008 Worlds Day 1 John Anderson DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Greedo's Scum.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[John Anderson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
